overview_text: This interdisciplinary program is designed for students with both a strong interest in the financial industry and in the areas of mathematical modeling and computational programming. Building on a strong core of foundational courses, advanced analytical work in finance, mathematics, and computer programming focuses on the financial strategies and computational technologies that prepare students for careers in the rapidly changing financial industry, including fintech, risk management, quantitative portfolio management, machine learning, and financial modeling.
